verdict.rationale: Anrok's dashboard shows exposure/obligations by jurisdiction, filings can be fetched via API, and certificates/registrations are tracked, supporting jurisdiction-level liability visibility and filing-ready detail. However, there is no explicit evidence of a real-time 'collected vs owed' accrual view, nor documented GL/accountant-consumable export formats. missing for 10: explicit collected-vs-owed accrual reporting, documented GL/accounting export formats (e.g., CSV/QuickBooks/NetSuite journal exports), and independent confirmation of finance-lead usability.
